newsitem.title: USA: Microchip Technology to offer 1 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Microchip Technology to offer 1 mln shrs.

text.p: Microchip Technology Inc said Wednesday it intends to file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of one million shares of common stock.
The company said it intends to use the net proceeds from the offering to reduce its outstanding indebtedness, for working capital and capital expenditures.
A statement from the company did not say how much money it plans to raise through the offering.
The company said the offering will be made only by means of a prospectus.
